metadata.description: Version 1 answer of vibe prompt flags --json: ready-to-paste launch flags for one harness kind or named launcher. Flags only and never a program, which is what lets the output be appended to any wrapper, alias or launcher a developer already has.

One environment assignment the launch makes for the harness it starts. Empty for every kind whose carrier is a flag or a file; a harness whose carrier is a configuration document has one, and that document carries the harness's own base prompt and the lane's PATH rather than the lane's bytes.
